title: Speaking — Handling interruptions
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on handling interruptions.

questions: What did you last use your phone for?
When do you prefer to put your phone away?
Which phone feature do you find especially useful?
Has your phone changed how you arrange to meet people?
What usually interrupts your work or study?
Do you find it easy to return to a task after a break?

part2.topic: Describe a time when handling an interruption well helped you finish something.
points: how you returned to the task
part2.closing: and explain what the experience taught you about concentration.

questions: What can managers do to reduce unnecessary work interruptions?
When are interruptions valuable for a team?
How has everyday life connected with handling interruptions changed for people of different ages?
